_meta.what: Estimated TRUE stint totals for pre-1999 DEFENSE entries (1960s-1990s), with a verdict on whether the legacy counting stats are stint totals or career/decade totals. See tools/reference/estimated_def_notes.md.
_meta.span: Only seasons with that franchise inside the entry decade. 1990s entries stop at 1998 (nflverse supplies 1999). `seasons` comes from estimated_stats_pre1999.json.

fields.sk: sacks in the stint; official from 1982, researched unofficial figures (Turney / Pro Football Researchers style) before that. Pre-1982 linebacker sacks are rough stint shares of the career figure; omitted where no basis
fields.skUnofficial: true when sk includes any pre-1982 season; false when sk is absent or all official
fields.skOfficial: official (1982+) part of sk, only for stints that straddle 1982 and where recalled
fields.int: interceptions (omitted for DE/DT, whose few picks are not reliably recalled)
fields.ff: forced fumbles: omitted everywhere (not reliably recalled; not tracked before about 1990)
fields.fr: fumble recoveries: omitted everywhere (not reliably recalled by stint)
fields.allPro1Seasons: AP first-team All-Pro seasons inside the stint (AFL entries: All-AFL). When given, [] means none.
fields.proBowlSeasons: Pro Bowl seasons inside the stint (AFL entries: AFL All-Star). When given, [] means none.
fields.dpoySeasons: AP Defensive Player of the Year seasons inside the stint (award began 1971; NEA/UPI awards not counted)
fields.verdict: stint-ok when legacy sk and int are within max(2, 20% of estimate) of the estimate; otherwise the author labels the likely cause
fields.certainty: author's confidence in the estimate: high|med|low
